entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: The Hunt Caller of the Atarka clan in the altered timeline, a fierce, weaponless fighter who leads hunts to feed the dragonlord; in another timeline he was khan of the Temur.

entities.name: Surrak's second
entities.description: An enormous man who is Surrak's second-in-command on the hunt and later tries to blame him to Atarka.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The enormous dragonlord who demands regular offerings of meat and rules the mountain clan.

entities.name: Atarka clan
entities.description: The clan that hunts to feed its dragonlord, with Surrak as Hunt Caller.

entities.name: Madness-struck dragon
entities.description: A thirty-foot antlered dragon of Atarka's brood that goes mad or desperate and steals the hunters' kill before Surrak kills it.

entities.name: Krushok
entities.description: An enormous old, clever mountain krushok hunted by Surrak's party, killed after it kills several hunters.

entities.name: Ainok family
entities.description: A hidden ainok family who do not serve Atarka but answer the hunting horn.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: The clan Surrak ruled in another timeline.

entities.name: Ayagor
entities.description: The mountaintop stone bowl where Atarka lounges and receives offerings.

entities.name: Atarka's mountains
entities.description: Vast, trackless mountains ruled by Atarka.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane in its altered timeline of dragonlords.

events.summary: The hunting horn sounds across the mountains and a family of hidden ainok rise to answer it.
events.quote: The horn sounds, and they walk.

events.summary: Surrak leads a hunt for an enormous mountain krushok to feed Atarka, taking elk, saberclaws, yeti, and a hermit along the way.
events.quote: An offering like that could keep the dragonlord satisfied for almost a week.

events.summary: A sick-looking dragon of Atarka's brood circles the sledge before leaving, and Surrak notes the rule of the hunt: bring Atarka the meat or become the meal.
events.quote: We bring her the meat, or we become the meal.

events.summary: The hunters trap the krushok, but it breaks free and kills several before Surrak's second spears it.
events.quote: With a powerful thrust, he drove the spear upwards under the beast's great jaw.

events.summary: The mad dragon dives from the clouds, scorches the party, and begins eating the krushok meant for Atarka.
events.quote: It stomped over to the krushok, and took a gluttonous bite while the surviving hunters scattered into the treeline.

events.summary: Surrak confronts the dragon, drawing on the land's energy, and kills it with a single punch that breaks its neck.
events.quote: The dragon fell to the earth, neck broken.

events.summary: Trapped by a storm, Surrak uses the dragon's organ for dragonfire and the hunters eat dragon for the first time.
events.quote: Surrak had never eaten dragon before. It was delicious.

events.summary: Surrak delivers the offering to Atarka at the Ayagor with the traditional words.
events.quote: Great Atarka, dragonlord and protector. This is a gift. Spare us, and there will be more.

events.summary: Surrak's second tells Atarka that Surrak killed one of her brood; Atarka says 'Take care of it,' and Surrak defeats the second when he attacks with a knife.
events.quote: With a burst of speed, Surrak slammed his fist into his second's ribs, cracking several, and sending the knife clattering along the stone.

relations.note: He is her Hunt Caller who feeds her.
relations.quote: Now he is the Hunt Caller of the Atarka clan, who hunt to feed their dragonlord.

relations.note: He leads the hunts as Hunt Caller.
relations.quote: I am the Hunt Caller," he tried to say.

relations.note: He is Surrak's second on the hunt.
He breaks its neck with one punch.
relations.quote: The dragon fell to the earth, neck broken.

relations.note: His second betrays him, and Surrak breaks his ribs.
relations.quote: Surrak killed one of your brood to defend your offering.
a rack of jagged antlers that marked it as one of Atarka's brood.

relations.note: In another timeline he was khan of the Temur.
relations.quote: On another Tarkir, with a different destiny, the man called Surrak was khan of his clan.
